name: MltBlock
meaning: language block of a .MLT file: Mlt_MapLanguageToBlock 0x548d76 turns the config language (GameLanguage) into one of these in place, and Load_MLT_ParseBank 0x548980 skips to it; other values pass through unchanged

name: MLT_BLOCK_BRAZILIAN
meaning: read for config language 3 (GAME_LANG_BRAZILIAN); the only non-consecutive entry
